# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta26

## Google Satellite availability in the Visual Editor

- Keep **Google Satellite** visible in the **Map underlay** selector so users can discover that the feature exists.
- Disable the Google Satellite option when the Navimower integration reports that the Google Map Tiles backend is unavailable.
- Show an explicit reason directly in the option label:
  - **Google Satellite — requires Google Map Tiles API setup** when no API key has been configured.
  - **Google Satellite — check Google Map Tiles API setup** when a key is configured but the provider is currently unavailable, for example after an authentication/configuration error.
- Re-enable the normal **Google Satellite** option automatically once the integration advertises it as available.
- Read only the existing integration-provided `frontend.map_underlays.google_satellite.configured/available` metadata; the API key itself remains backend-only and is never exposed to the Map Card.

This removes the confusing Visual Editor path where Google Satellite could be selected without a usable Google Map Tiles configuration and then appear as an empty map background.

No Navimower integration update is required beyond a version that already exposes the current Google underlay metadata.
